# Final Execution Plan

The Awtsmoos renews the road before the traveler takes the next pace;
Awtsmoos.com should let every refactor leave less confusion and more usable space.

## Phase A — close our own shared-social delta

1. Trace all imports/exports of `SocialExperienceInstaller.js`.
2. Split stylesheet definitions from ambient startup and installer lifecycle.
3. Rewrite the installer facade completely around those modules.
4. Re-read all three files and verify each remains focused and compact.

## Phase B — shared primitive cleanup

5. Read `IdentityMiniSheet.js`, `UniversalAddSheet.js`, `SocialGestureAdapter.js` fully.
6. Trace consumers and tests before changing any public contract.
7. Rewrite complete files and split genuine responsibilities into smaller modules.
8. Keep all sheet UI rooted in the shared social experience and use the common DOM factory.
9. Preserve action semantics, focus lifecycle, and gesture cleanup contracts.

## Phase C — native capability center

10. Reconcile staged capability catalog with current native `RouteModel.js`.
11. Create native modules inside Social Hub with real route IDs only.
12. Add one localized CSS import to the existing Social Hub manifest.
13. Mount through verified HubApp/AppAssembly lifecycle without editing monolithic HTML.

## Phase D — reader extraction

14. Locate exact reader template and all linked scripts/styles.
15. Extract inline critical styles into localized reader-shell imports.
16. Split menu state/view/controller and unread-mail indicator.
17. Replace literal layer values with reader-local z tokens and safe-area rules.
18. Preserve existing IDs, events, reader data flows, and post/commentary behavior.

## Phase E — expansion

19. Inspect Heichelos data/ranking/card source and improve information quality hierarchy.
20. Inspect profile/alias identity flows and collapse advanced identity controls progressively.
21. Inspect comments, notifications, composer, and editors for the same shared primitives.
22. Run syntax, import, focused tests, then browser/mobile/runtime verification.
23. Re-read touched files, compare planned versus actual, and continue through every discovered delta.
